findings.summary: The persisted shadow-training records self-report `logged_for_laya: false`: serialization occurs before the flag is set true. The routing choice is nevertheless actually appended with request, tier, cost, and escalation data, so this does not impair the node's present role, but consumers should not use that field as evidence of write success.

reasoning: The implementation remains a focused, standalone three-tier router: it selects instant actions, fast-model responses, or a full agent and appends every routed decision when logging is enabled (router/cost_aware.py:139-143, 146-201). The record contains the selected tier and decision context, preserving the node's why that the choice be logged for Laya. No graph configuration or public dependency contract was changed. This node has no declared depends_on or unlocks, and the foundational bridge node likewise declares no edge to it (/Users/sab-mini/repos/gddp-config/graphs/agentos-core/nodes/cost-aware-model-router.yaml; /Users/sab-mini/repos/gddp-config/graphs/agentos-core/nodes/bridge-multi-client.yaml), so the static bridge-related sample content creates no unmodeled runtime dependency. The only observed inconsistency is the non-authoritative persisted boolean noted above.
